maddeler.e:
أخشوشن (form XII)
# أَخْشَوْشِنُ (ʔaḵšawšinu) /ʔax.ʃaw.ʃi.nu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِخْشَوْشَنَ (iḵšawšana)
# أَخْشَوْشِنَ (ʔaḵšawšina) /ʔax.ʃaw.ʃi.na/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِخْشَوْشَنَ (iḵšawšana)
# أَخْشَوْشِنْ (ʔaḵšawšin) /ʔax.ʃaw.ʃin/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِخْشَوْشَنَ (iḵšawšana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
